findings.reason: Roster last_change can report an older commit with last_change_scanned true, which is a wrong value in the goal-named seat-scoped latest-change view (B3).
roster --live (B8) reports a false threads outage when no clones are seated, and it keeps stale refusals once the seated set empties.
No test covers the success branch of the roster --live threads snapshot, so a regression in goal-named B8 behavior would pass the suite.
The kept malformed tree row is deliberate and visibly flagged; the finding is a contract-documentation gap (spec and README) and does not change whether log is correct.
Duplicated serde-word helper is a structure/refactor concern with no effect on correctness.
The reconciler's one-seat finalize read can overwrite the snapshot, so roster --live (B8) shows dropped refusals or a spurious threads-unavailable result.
